name: OpenVibe.Sources

exposure.note: internal ingestion service; sources.openvibe.network says so (its API is loopback-only)

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else (the database and dependencies are what ready checks)

drains: scheduler stopped; runs in flight get up to 15 s to finish
open HTTP connections closed, then the server
shutdown.note: the forced exit after 20 s exits 1

resumes.what: sources whose next_due_at passed during the stop are fetched on the first ticks, oldest first
unsent events in the outbox table go to OpenVibe.Events once the relay starts (at least once; Events dedupes by event_id)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart (30 s in host.example.json); manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: the schema code only adds (CREATE … IF NOT EXISTS, ADD COLUMN; no DROP, RENAME or table rebuild), which an older release ignores

leases.none: no claims: one process owns sources.db (better-sqlite3, single writer); a second run of a source already in flight is refused in memory

notes: Source registry and ingestion workers (RSS/Atom, sitemaps, JSON-LD, mapped official APIs, manual). Every item carries provenance; every fetch is a recorded run with an explicit state; failures never create or modify items.
